authority_boundary.canonical_identity_and_specs: Use licensed external product content only after field-level validation.
authority_boundary.seller_price_stock_warranty: Use approved HEXBAY shop listings only. External prices are never treated as live LKR offers.
authority_boundary.recommendation_eligibility: Only verified canonical products with an active in-stock HEXBAY listing may be recommended.

sources.name: Open Icecat
sources.licence: Open Icecat open content licence; respect per-brand syndication and digital-asset rights.
sources.access: Free registration is required. Match products by brand plus manufacturer part number or GTIN and request only Open Icecat-authorized content.
limitations: Coverage is limited to participating Open Icecat brands.
Some rich media assets have separate access restrictions.
Does not provide authoritative HEXBAY seller price or stock.

sources.name: TechFuelHQ PC Builder Parts Dataset
sources.attribution: TechFuelHQ PC Builder Parts Dataset (CC BY 4.0). https://techfuelhq.com/tools/pc-builder/
limitations: Does not contain monitors, keyboards, mice, or headsets.
Contains no current prices and must not be used as a seller feed.
Performance tiers are editorial rather than a substitute for benchmark evidence.

sources.name: docyx PC Part Dataset
sources.licence: Repository declares MIT; underlying records were scraped from PCPartPicker, so the repository licence alone is not accepted as proof of rights over upstream product data.
limitations: Never import its USD prices into HEXBAY.
Never use an unverified row as recommendation evidence.
Verify identity and required specifications against Open Icecat or manufacturer pages.
Dataset was last reported updated on 2025-07-23 and may contain discontinued products.

sources.name: HEXBAY approved seller listings
sources.licence: Seller-supplied marketplace records governed by HEXBAY terms.
limitations: A seller offer must map to one reviewed canonical product.
Synthetic demonstration offers must be labelled as fictional data.

rejected_as_primary_sources.reason: Usually stale, region-specific, weakly structured, and not authoritative for compatibility or Sri Lankan stock.

rejected_as_primary_sources.source: Foreign retailer APIs such as Best Buy or eBay
rejected_as_primary_sources.reason: Useful for discovery but not authoritative for local HEXBAY seller inventory, warranty, or LKR price.
Unclear rights, fragile fields, and unacceptable provenance for a real-world marketplace recommender.
